cli by ejmlabs

A coding agent that lives in your terminal and stays light.

One native Rust binary. Read only until you grant more. Built to run a hundred sessions without flooding the machine it runs on.

Build from source v0.1.0 source release, not yet packaged

Built for the terminal you already use

  • A real composer

    Unicode, multiline input, bracketed paste and message history. Paste a stack trace without sending it by accident.

  • Readable streaming

    Code, Markdown and diffs are styled as they arrive. Control sequences in model and tool output are stripped, never run. Light and dark palettes use the ejmlabs brand colors, and --appearance picks one.

  • Steer mid-run

    Queue the next turn, redirect the current one, or stop it. Every run state stays visible.

  • Saved sessions

    Pick up any session by ID or prefix. Durable history lives in the harness, not in your scrollback.

  • Pipes and scripts

    ejm-cli run streams plain text, or one JSON event per line with --json. Failures exit nonzero.

  • Clean exits

    Raw mode, mouse tracking and the alternate screen are restored after errors, signals and panics.

You grant every permission

File tools start read only. Writing and shell access are flags you pass on purpose, and the grants stay visible in the header for the life of the process.

Keys come from environment variables and are never accepted as arguments. Native execution runs as you and is not a sandbox, so ejm-cli doctor reports exactly what is enforced.

# read only
ejm-cli

# let it edit files
ejm-cli --allow-write

# and run commands
ejm-cli --allow-write --allow-shell

Light by design

No Node or Python runtime. Agents share one resource governor instead of opening a shell each, and rendering memory has a hard ceiling.

  • 100managed sessions by default
  • 8 / 4 / 1model requests, local jobs and heavy jobs at once
  • 256 KiBcap on visible transcript memory
  • 24 msfirst composer paint, fresh state

Paint time measured on 18 October 2026 on a Mac16,8 with a replay provider, from process start to first paint in a real PTY. Warm p95 was 41 ms across 20 samples. A modern Mac does not prove the old-laptop target, and no comparison with other agents has run yet.

Bring your own model

  • OpenAI compatible

    Any Chat Completions endpoint. Set EJM_CLI_BASE_URL and EJM_CLI_MODEL.

  • OpenAI Responses

    Native Responses access with your API key.

  • ChatGPT

    ejm-cli login chatgpt signs in through your browser. Tokens never touch arguments, logs or the screen.

  • Anthropic

    Native Anthropic API access with an explicit model.

Get cli

cli is a source release and has not been published or packaged yet. It builds against ejm-harness, the open engine it runs on, checked out as a sibling directory.

cargo build --release --locked
./target/release/ejm-cli --replay

MIT licensed. Rust only. Run ejm-cli --help for every command and flag.

Small experiments. Useful things.
